outcome.description: recorded means a scoped documentation change is pushed to a reviewable PR; already_documented means cited maintained guidance covers the lesson; blocked means the assignment could not be completed.

learning.description: The supplied reusable lesson and its applicable conditions; do not invent a lesson to fill this field.

evidence.description: Source references supporting the lesson. For already_documented, include the guidance location.

destination_pr_url.description: Documentation PR URL; empty if no PR exists. A partial PR does not establish recorded.

files_changed.description: Guidance paths changed by this assignment.

reason.description: What was recorded, where the lesson is already documented, or the failed step and evidence or decision needed to proceed.
